flows.title: Guardian recommendations expose no Accept, Approve or Execute control and are absent from autopilot
steps: 1. Select any fixture task with a guardian recommendation and open its Recommendations / proposals section.
2. Inspect the recommendation's action bar, its overflow menu and any keyboard shortcut hints.
3. Open the proposal autopilot or scheduled-proposals view if the UI provides one.
4. Select a fixture task with an ordinary executable proposal and inspect its action bar for comparison.
5. Do not click any accept or execute control at any point; observe only.
expected: No Accept, Approve, Run or Execute control is rendered anywhere for the guardian recommendation and the item is labelled informational or read-only.
The autopilot or scheduled-proposals view does not list the guardian recommendation.
The ordinary executable proposal still renders its Accept control, so the omission is specific to guardian recommendations.
